title: Outpatient and Part B Therapy Services — Coverage and Billability Conditions by Tier
content:
This matrix records four coverage and billability settings of **Outpatient and Part B Therapy Services**, tier by tier.

## Matrix

| Tier | Maintenance therapy covered when skilled care is needed | Therapy billable under Part B on a day in a Part A covered stay | Visits outside a signed, current plan of care billable to the payer or the resident | Visits after an overdue progress report billable to the payer and the resident |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Medicare Part B Physical Therapy Plan of Care | Yes | No | No | No |
| Medicare Part B Occupational Therapy Plan of Care | Yes | No | No | No |
| Medicare Part B Speech-Language Pathology Plan of Care | Yes | No | No | No |
| Medicare Advantage Outpatient Therapy Plan of Care | Yes | No | No | No |
| Medical Assistance Therapy Plan of Care | Yes | No | No | No |
| Private Pay Therapy Plan of Care | Yes | No | No | No |

## What each column states

1. **Maintenance therapy.** Skilled therapy to maintain function or slow decline is covered when skilled care is needed (the Jimmo settlement). The setting is Yes in every tier.
2. **Part A overlap.** Therapy may not be billed under Part B on a day the resident is in a Part A covered stay; that therapy is in the Part A per diem. The setting is No in every tier.
3. **Uncertified visits.** Visits outside a signed, current plan of care may not be billed to the payer or to the resident. The setting is No in every tier.
4. **Overdue progress report.** Visits after an overdue progress report do not remain billable to the payer or to the resident. The setting is No in every tier.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical visits)

| Hypothetical visit | Reading under this matrix |
|---|---|
| Therapy on a day the resident is in a Part A covered stay | Not billed under Part B; it is in the Part A per diem |
| A visit furnished after the signed plan of care's last covered day has passed | Billable to neither the payer nor the resident |
| A visit furnished while a progress report is overdue | Billable to neither the payer nor the resident |

**Is therapy that only maintains function covered?** Yes, in every tier, when skilled care is needed.
